name: Upload Patient Report
description: Admin selects a patient, picks one of their fulfilled appointments, the encounter is resolved automatically, then selects the test order (ServiceRequest) and uploads the result file. A Diagnostic Report is created linking the file to the order.

intent_examples: Upload a test report for a patient
Upload lab results for a patient
Attach a report to a patient's test order
Upload diagnostic report for an appointment
Record test results for a patient
Add a PDF report to a patient's service request
when_to_use: Admin wants to upload a result file (PDF, image) against a patient's ServiceRequest
Staff needs to attach a lab or imaging report to a completed appointment's order
User wants to create a DiagnosticReport linked to a specific test order for a patient
when_not_to_use: Patient is uploading their own report (use the patient medical records page instead)
User wants to create a diagnostic report without uploading a file (use create_diagnostic_report instead)
User wants to order a new test (use create_service_request instead)

introduction: I'll help you upload a report in 3 steps: select a patient, choose their completed appointment, then select the test order and upload the file.

completion.message: Report uploaded successfully. A Diagnostic Report has been created and linked to the test order.

workflow_steps.name: Select Patient
workflow_steps.description: Search for a patient by name. Their fulfilled appointments will be loaded in the next step.

workflow_steps.name: Select Appointment
workflow_steps.description: Select one of the patient's completed appointments. The encounter is resolved automatically — if no encounter exists for the selected appointment, the workflow stops.

encounter_id.error_message: No encounter found for this appointment. Please select an appointment that has an associated encounter before continuing.

context_resolvers.description: Load fulfilled appointments for the selected patient so the user can pick one.

workflow_steps.name: Upload Report
workflow_steps.description: Select the test order (ServiceRequest) this report belongs to, then upload the result file. A Diagnostic Report is created on submit.

context_resolvers.description: Load service requests for the resolved encounter so the user can select which test order this report belongs to.
